# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 29 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 29 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_029_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 3 — Truth

**1** Again he spoke to me: "Love truth, and let nothing but truth come out of your mouth, so that the spirit which God placed to dwell in this flesh may be found to be true by all, and so the Lord who dwells within you may be glorified. For the Lord is true in every word, and in him there is no falsehood whatsoever. **2** Those therefore who lie renounce the Lord and become defrauders of him, failing to return to him the deposit which they received. For they received from him a spirit free from all deceit. If they return it full of lies, they have dishonored and polluted the deposit that the true Lord gave them. **3** But those who are always truthful will be pleasing to God and will live to God." **4** "And what of those who falsify and lie?" "They will have no life with God, unless they repent and turn back from their lying and practice truth again. For those who repent of their lying are sanctified. Blessed are all who are righteous and keep the Lord's commandments."

---

*LOGOS note: The "deposit" (parathēkē) metaphor for the Spirit is also used in 2 Timothy 1:14 ("guard the good deposit"). The false-to-true repentance path (v.4) confirms the Shepherd's consistent mercy-within-urgency framework.*
